home.description: Replace the boring YouTube progress bar scrubber with animated cat GIFs. 12 built-in cats, custom GIF support, and a live customizer.
home.galleryDesc: Click a cat to preview it on the progress bar below.
home.feature1Desc: Carefully sized and positioned for the YouTube bar.
home.feature2Desc: Use any GIF as your custom scrubber.
home.feature3Desc: YouTube and YouTube Music, standard and mini player.

extension.heading: Get Nyan Progress Bar
extension.description: Free Chrome extension. Installs in seconds and works immediately on YouTube.
extension.feature1Desc: One click from the Chrome Web Store, no account needed.
extension.feature2Desc: Completely local. Your YouTube activity stays private.
extension.feature3Desc: Switch anytime from the popup, no page reload required.
extension.feature4Desc: Drop any GIF into the popup to use it as your scrubber.
extension.feature6Desc: Interface available in EN, ES, PT, VI, ID, FR, TL, TR, PL, DE, UK.
